what: Two-layer curtain covering the screen. The top curtain (ink-black) lifts upward over 1s power4.out after .5s (the fade variant blurs out over 1s power1.inOut), and the bottom curtain (navy→teal gradient) fades .4s later than the top one over 1s expo.inOut. At 1.9s the curtain is hidden and fx:done fires. The first page uses the lift, subpages use the fade, handing off the same curtain in different ways
ease: power4.out (top curtain lift) · power1.inOut (top curtain fade) · expo.inOut (bottom curtain)

options.look: lift (default — lifts away upward) · fade (fades out)
options.delay: Delay before the top curtain starts moving (sec), default .5
options.lag: Seconds the bottom panel lags behind the top one, default .4
options.back: With lift, the bottom curtain is not blurred either but lifts upward by −100% (ride-plus-a). Default is blur
options.back-dur: Bottom curtain duration (seconds), default same as dur — ride-plus-a .8
options.back-ease: Bottom curtain curve, in the form ‹0.87,0,0.13,1›, default expo.inOut

use: — When finished, fx:done fires (hook the body entrance here)

from.where: shared.js .fn-intro (first page lift · subpage fade — original Barba afterOnce intro-overlay-first/second)

shared.js [data-intro] (when entering from outside — the white curtain lifts upward after .5s over 1s power4.out, and the dark under-curtain lifts together .1s later over .8s expo.inOut. When arriving from another of our pages, there is no curtain, only the body turns on)
from.options: look: lift; back: lift; dur: 1; back-dur: .8; delay: .5; lag: .1
